facts.value: California High School Proficiency Examination and other high school equivalency diplomas
Students must submit additional high school transcripts or SAT or ACT scores to satisfy course competency and aptitude requirements for admission.

Enrollment and successful completion of 24 semester credits with a 2.75 minimum GPA through Earned Admission, or completion of 24 or more college credits from a regionally accredited college or university with a minimum of 2.50 cumulative GPA on a 4.00 scale.
